title: Affordable Home Development Master Plan Overview
description:
The City of San Diego City Planning Department is creating the Affordable Home Development Master Plan to evaluate possibilities to use City-owned land to support future homes and shelter opportunities.
 
As part of this effort, City Planning staff have identified 11 sites across the City with strong potential for future homes while maintaining or expanding City services.
 
For more information please visit sandiego.gov/AffordableHomesPlan.
